meta.title: 100-App Agent Toolkit & MCP Buildability Audit
meta.pipeline_summary: 3-pass research & verification pipeline (Pass 1 Discovery -> Pass 2 Live Doc Grounding & Critic -> Pass 3 Stratified 20-App Human Audit)

top_blockers.blocker: Production App Review / Business Verification (Sandbox Free, Prod Gated)
Paid Plan / Enterprise Tier Gate (No Free API Tier)
Hard Partner / Sales-Gated Access (No Self-Serve Sandbox)
Per-Tenant Subdomain / Multi-Region Routing / Dual-Key Quirk
No Public OAuth2 (Static Token / Unscoped Basic Auth Only)
CLI-Only / No Hosted API (Needs Sandboxed Skill Wrapper)

diffs.pass2_value: REST / Ship with Caveats (Authorization: Key ID:SECRET)
diffs.reason: Hint URL (higgsfield.ai/cli) misled Pass 1 into classifying it as CLI-only; live doc verification on docs.higgsfield.ai uncovered a full async REST API + SDKs.
Developer portal rebranded to Commas (commasdocs.com) serving fanbasis.com/public-api/* with scoped x-api-key and a free sandbox at api-sandbox.commas.net.
Live check of Oct 2026 Help Center confirmed self-serve Settings -> MCP & API keys on free accounts with full CRUD for contacts, tags, courses, and subscriptions.

diffs.pass2_value: API Key + OAuth2 / Official MCP (OAuth 2.1 only)
diffs.reason: Live 2026 verification revealed dual surfaces: Official MCP (OAuth 2.1 only, unsuitable for headless cron agents) AND Public API (clay-api-key header).
Live crawl of waterfall.mintlify.app/v1/authentication confirmed explicit sales gate: 'Contact the team for API access and pricing.'

diffs.pass2_value: Sandbox Free, Prod Gated (OAuth requires Tech Partnership)
diffs.reason: Oct 2026 Aircall docs clarify Basic Auth works for existing customers, but multi-tenant OAuth2 client ID/secret requires joining Tech Partnerships.

diffs.pass2_value: OAuth2 + Bearer / PAT (v2/v3) / Paid Plan Required ($97+/mo)
diffs.reason: Nov 2026 Help Center confirmed API v1 reached EOL Dec 31, 2025; modern integrations require v2/v3 OAuth2 or Private Integration Tokens on paid plans.
Oct 30, 2026 Help Center confirmed Otter launched an official remote Streamable HTTP MCP server over OAuth despite having no general REST API.
Live Plain GraphQL docs confirmed fine-grained Machine User API keys, OAuth apps, an official MCP server, and an official Agent Skill.
Pass 1 hallucinated generic payment gateway copy from name alone; live doc check confirmed FX spread auditing API + Official MCP with free 10/day tier.

diffs.pass2_value: Bearer / PAT (v3 cog_ Service User Keys required for MCP)
diffs.reason: Live docs.devin.ai verification caught that legacy apk_ keys are deprecated and explicitly rejected by the Devin MCP server.
Nov 2026 docs confirmed HTTP Basic Auth (email:token) with zero scope restrictions tied to a user account, and no self-serve signup.

apps.name: Salesforce
apps.one_liner: Enterprise cloud CRM for sales pipelines, accounts, and customer operations.
apps.main_blocker: API access requires Enterprise+ edition (or Dev Edition); External Client App + admin enablement for prod/MCP.
apps.notes: Free Developer Edition sandbox available; official Headless 360 MCP in beta requires Enterprise+ and admin setup.

apps.name: HubSpot
apps.one_liner: Inbound CRM, marketing, sales, and service platform with unified objects.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free developer account + test portals; Private App tokens and public OAuth2 apps both self-serve. Official MCP works on all plans (no deletes).

apps.name: Pipedrive
apps.one_liner: Sales-focused pipeline CRM for SMB deal tracking and activity management.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free developer sandbox via Developer Hub; OAuth2 for marketplace apps and API tokens for direct access. Official MCP launched June 2026.

apps.name: Attio
apps.one_liner: Data-driven, flexible CRM with customizable objects, lists, and workflows.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free tier includes API access; clean REST API with OAuth2 and Bearer keys. Official OAuth-only remote MCP available on all plans.

apps.name: Twenty
apps.one_liner: Open-source, schema-driven modern CRM deployable on cloud or self-hosted.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Schema-per-tenant REST & GraphQL APIs auto-generated per workspace (100 req/min, batch up to 60); self-hostable via Docker.

apps.name: Podio
apps.one_liner: Customizable collaborative workspace and lightweight CRM by Progress/Citrix.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free plan supports OAuth2 client credentials and app-level auth; older API ergonomics and strict per-hour rate limits.

apps.name: Zoho CRM
apps.one_liner: Multi-region SMB and enterprise CRM within the Zoho business suite.
apps.main_blocker: Multi-DC regional endpoints (.com, .in, .eu, .com.au) require dynamic api_domain routing per user.
apps.notes: Free developer edition; Zoho-oauthtoken header format and multi-region DC handling must be managed by the toolkit.

apps.name: Close
apps.one_liner: Inside-sales CRM with built-in calling, SMS, and email sequences.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: 14-day self-serve trial; supports API keys via Basic Auth and OAuth2 for multi-tenant apps. Official scoped MCP available.

apps.name: Copper
apps.one_liner: Google Workspace-native CRM designed for relationship-driven sales teams.
apps.main_blocker: Developer API requires Professional or Business plan; uses custom X-PW-AccessToken + X-PW-UserEmail headers (no OAuth2).
apps.notes: 14-day trial available, but production API access is gated to higher paid tiers and lacks standard OAuth2.

apps.name: DealCloud
apps.one_liner: Enterprise capital-markets and deal-management CRM by Intapp.
apps.main_blocker: Enterprise customer instance + admin group enablement required; no self-serve developer sandbox.
apps.notes: Docs confirm OAuth2 Client Credentials flow, but tenant URL and API user-group activation require an existing Intapp DealCloud contract.

apps.name: Zendesk
apps.one_liner: Enterprise customer service, ticketing, messaging, and knowledge-base suite.
apps.main_blocker: Per-customer subdomain ({subdomain}.zendesk.com) required; Global OAuth approval needed for public multi-tenant apps.
apps.notes: Free trial + developer sandbox available; Global OAuth client requires Zendesk review before public distribution.

apps.name: Intercom
apps.one_liner: Customer messaging, live chat, helpdesk, and AI support agent platform.
apps.main_blocker: Public OAuth app distribution requires Intercom App Store review; official MCP currently US-hosted workspaces only.
apps.notes: Free developer workspace available; Bearer access tokens for internal apps, OAuth2 for multi-tenant apps. Official 13-tool remote MCP.

apps.name: Freshdesk
apps.one_liner: Cloud helpdesk and omnichannel customer support ticketing platform.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free tier includes REST API via Basic Auth (API key as username, 'X' as password) scoped to customer subdomain.

apps.name: Front
apps.one_liner: Collaborative shared inbox and customer operations hub across email, chat, and SMS.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free developer sandbox; supports API tokens and OAuth2. Official open-beta OAuth MCP server exposes conversations, drafts, and replies.

apps.name: Pylon
apps.one_liner: B2B customer support platform built around Slack, Teams, email, and ticketing.
apps.main_blocker: No OAuth2 flow (admin-issued Bearer tokens only) and requires B2B workspace; US/EU regional base URL routing.
apps.notes: Verified Oct 2026 docs: Bearer token with regional prefix (pylon_api_us / eu), optional IP allowlist, and bot identities.

apps.name: LiveAgent
apps.one_liner: Helpdesk ticketing, live chat, and call center software for SMB support teams.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free trial available; API v3 authenticates via apikey header on customer subdomain with Swagger/OpenAPI spec.

apps.name: Plain
apps.one_liner: Modern B2B technical support platform with GraphQL-first API and agent workflows.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Verified live docs: Machine-user scoped API keys (Bearer plainApiKey_xxx) + OAuth apps, GraphQL SDK, official MCP server, and Agent Skill.

apps.name: Help Scout
apps.one_liner: Customer support shared inbox, help center, and live chat for growing teams.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free tier/trial available; Mailbox API 2.0 supports OAuth2 Authorization Code and Client Credentials flows.

apps.name: Gorgias
apps.one_liner: Ecommerce-focused customer support helpdesk tightly integrated with Shopify/Magento.
apps.main_blocker: Requires active Gorgias store/paid trial (or Partner sandbox) and per-domain base URL; OAuth2 requires partner app registration.
apps.notes: Basic Auth (email + API key) works for single tenants; OAuth2 available via Gorgias Developer Portal for public apps.

apps.name: Gladly
apps.one_liner: Customer-centric enterprise omnichannel contact center and helpdesk.
apps.main_blocker: Enterprise-only platform (no self-serve signup/sandbox); HTTP Basic API tokens are completely unscoped and tied to a user.
apps.notes: Verified Nov 2026 docs: {org}.gladly.com/api/v1/ with Basic Auth (email:token), 10 req/s/method, no OAuth2, no scopes.

apps.name: Slack
apps.one_liner: Workplace messaging, channels, workflows, and app platform.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free workspace + instant OAuth2 app creation; Slack also ships an official remote MCP server (requires workspace admin approval).

apps.name: Twilio
apps.one_liner: Programmable cloud communications API for SMS, voice, WhatsApp, and video.
apps.main_blocker: Free trial restricts outbound SMS/calls to verified numbers; US A2P 10DLC carrier registration needed for prod SMS.
apps.notes: Self-serve Account SID + Auth Token / API Key Secret; official Twilio Labs MCP server wraps OpenAPI specs.

apps.name: Zoho Cliq
apps.one_liner: Team chat, channels, bots, and workplace messaging inside the Zoho ecosystem.
apps.main_blocker: Multi-DC OAuth server routing (accounts.zoho.{dc}) and Zoho-oauthtoken header prefix.
apps.notes: Verified live v3 OAuth docs: free Zoho workspace, standard OAuth2 authorization code flow with 1-hour access tokens and refresh tokens.

apps.name: Lark (Larksuite)
apps.one_liner: All-in-one collaboration suite (messaging, docs, calendar, base) by ByteDance.
apps.main_blocker: Strict domain split between International (open.larksuite.com) and China Feishu (open.feishu.cn); tenant vs user token distinction.
apps.notes: Verified live docs: free developer console, App ID/Secret for tenant_access_token + OAuth2 for user_access_token; official OpenAPI MCP repo.

apps.name: Pumble
apps.one_liner: Team messaging and workspace chat app by CAKE.com.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Verified live docs: API addon available on ALL plans (including Free); generates API keys via /api-keys generate for Swagger REST API (1000 req/min).

apps.name: Discord
apps.one_liner: Voice, video, and community text chat platform with rich bot and slash-command APIs.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Instant free Developer Portal; Bot tokens + OAuth2. Privileged Gateway Intents (e.g., Message Content) require verification only past 100 servers.

apps.name: Telegram
apps.one_liner: Encrypted cloud messaging platform with Bot API and MTProto client protocol.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Zero-friction bot token creation via @BotFather; clean HTTP Bot API for agents (user-account MTProto requires phone auth).

apps.name: WhatsApp Business
apps.one_liner: Official Meta Cloud API for business messaging, templates, and customer chat.
apps.main_blocker: Production requires Meta Business Verification, approved message templates, and dedicated phone number registration.
apps.notes: Free test number in Meta Developer Portal, but production messaging is tightly gated by Meta Business + App Review.

apps.name: Aircall
apps.one_liner: Cloud business phone system and voice platform for sales and support teams.
apps.main_blocker: Basic Auth works for existing customers, but OAuth2 client credentials require joining Aircall's Tech Partnerships program.
apps.notes: Verified Oct 2026 docs: 60 req/min limit; only Aircall Admins can complete OAuth consent; partner program gate for OAuth2.

apps.name: Vonage
apps.one_liner: Cloud communications APIs for SMS, voice, video, verify, and omnichannel messaging.
apps.main_blocker: Free trial credits available, but Voice/Messages APIs use RS256 JWTs with private keys while legacy SMS uses API key/secret.
apps.notes: Self-serve developer dashboard; mixed auth across API families (JWT for newer APIs, API Key/Secret for legacy SMS).

apps.name: Google Ads
apps.one_liner: Search, display, and YouTube advertising campaign management and reporting API.
apps.main_blocker: Requires MCC Developer Token review (Test -> Basic -> Standard access) plus Google OAuth verification.
apps.notes: Test accounts are self-serve, but touching real production accounts requires Developer Token application and Google review.

apps.name: Meta Ads
apps.one_liner: Facebook and Instagram campaign creation, targeting, and ads insights API.
apps.main_blocker: Requires Meta App Review (ads_management/ads_read), Business Verification, and strict rate-limit/tier progression.
apps.notes: Development mode is free for owned ad accounts; multi-tenant production access requires full Meta App Review + Business Verification.

apps.name: LinkedIn Ads
apps.one_liner: B2B campaign management, lead gen forms, and ad analytics on LinkedIn.
apps.main_blocker: Advertising API requires explicit application and LinkedIn Marketing Developer approval (Development -> Standard tier).
apps.notes: OAuth2 3-legged flow; every app must apply for Advertising API access and prove legitimate business/SaaS use case.

apps.name: GoHighLevel
apps.one_liner: White-label agency CRM, marketing automation, funnels, and messaging platform.
apps.main_blocker: No free tier (plans start at $97/mo; API v1 hit EOL Dec 2025). API v2/v3 uses OAuth2 Marketplace apps or Private Integration Tokens.
apps.notes: Verified Nov 2026 docs: V1 deprecated Dec 31, 2025; V2/V3 OAuth2 + PIT available across paid plans with some endpoints restricted to Founder ($497/mo).

apps.name: Mailchimp
apps.one_liner: Email marketing, audience segmentation, automations, and transactional email.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free tier includes Marketing API; API key (with datacenter prefix like us19) via Basic Auth or OAuth2 for multi-tenant apps.

apps.name: Klaviyo
apps.one_liner: Ecommerce email, SMS marketing automation, and customer data platform.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free developer account; versioned REST API with Private API Keys (Klaviyo-API-Key) and OAuth2. Official MCP server available.

apps.name: systeme.io
apps.one_liner: All-in-one sales funnels, email campaigns, courses, and digital product builder.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Verified Oct 2026 docs: Free plan includes Settings -> MCP & API keys (up to 3 keys/account); covers contacts, tags, courses, webhooks, subscriptions.

apps.name: Pinterest
apps.one_liner: Visual discovery, pins, boards, catalog, and Pinterest Ads API (v5).
apps.main_blocker: Trial app access is self-serve/sandboxed; Standard production API access requires Pinterest app review and video demo.
apps.notes: API v5 uses OAuth2; Trial tier allows testing on owned accounts while public production usage requires Standard access approval.

apps.name: Threads (Meta)
apps.one_liner: Meta's public text/media conversation network API for publishing, replies, and insights.
apps.main_blocker: Testing requires explicit Threads Tester invites; public release needs Meta App Review; private-profile tokens expire after 60 days without refresh.
apps.notes: Verified live Meta docs: OAuth 2.0 user tokens (1h short-lived -> 60d long-lived), separate Threads App ID/Secret, public URL needed for media publishing.

apps.name: SendGrid
apps.one_liner: Cloud transactional and marketing email delivery platform by Twilio.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Self-serve API keys via Bearer header; domain/sender verification required before live sending to avoid spam blocks.

apps.name: Shopify
apps.one_liner: Leading ecommerce storefront, orders, inventory, and checkout platform.
apps.main_blocker: REST Admin API is legacy (GraphQL required for new public apps); App Store review needed for public distribution and protected customer data.
apps.notes: Free Partner account + dev stores; OAuth2 per-shop ({shop}.myshopify.com). Official Storefront & Dev MCP servers available.

apps.name: WooCommerce
apps.one_liner: Open-source WordPress ecommerce plugin with self-hosted REST API.
apps.main_blocker: Self-hosted per-merchant WordPress URL; requires HTTPS Basic Auth (Consumer Key/Secret) or OAuth 1.0a over HTTP.
apps.notes: 100% self-serve on any WordPress site; toolkit must accept user-supplied base domain and handle varied hosting/WAF setups.

apps.name: BigCommerce
apps.one_liner: Open-SaaS ecommerce platform with catalog, orders, storefront, and GraphQL APIs.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free developer sandbox store; store-level X-Auth-Token API keys for private apps and OAuth2 for multi-tenant marketplace apps.

apps.name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
apps.one_liner: Enterprise B2C/B2B headless commerce platform (SCAPI / OCAPI).
apps.main_blocker: No self-serve free sandbox; requires enterprise SFCC license or Salesforce Partner Account Manager provisioning.
apps.notes: SLAS (Shopper Login & API Access) + Account Manager OAuth2; public docs exist but obtaining a real instance/tenant is enterprise-gated.

apps.name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
apps.one_liner: Enterprise and open-source ecommerce platform with REST and GraphQL APIs.
apps.main_blocker: Open-source Magento can be self-hosted for dev, while Adobe Commerce Cloud requires enterprise license; per-store base URL + OAuth 1.0a/Bearer/IMS.
apps.notes: Complex dual ecosystem: self-hosted Magento Open Source uses integration tokens/OAuth 1.0a, while Adobe Commerce SaaS uses Adobe IMS OAuth2.

apps.name: Squarespace
apps.one_liner: Website builder and online store platform with Commerce APIs for orders and inventory.
apps.main_blocker: Commerce API keys require Commerce Advanced plan; OAuth2 access requires Squarespace Extensions partnership approval.
apps.notes: API keys work on Commerce Advanced plans (Bearer header); public multi-tenant OAuth is partner-gated via Extensions.

apps.name: Ecwid
apps.one_liner: Embeddable ecommerce shopping cart and storefront platform by Lightspeed.
apps.main_blocker: API access requires a paid Ecwid plan (Venture+); free developer test store available upon partner registration.
apps.notes: Clean REST API with Bearer tokens and OAuth2 for public apps; store ID required in every request path.

apps.name: Gumroad
apps.one_liner: Creator commerce platform for selling digital products, licenses, and memberships.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free creator account; instant OAuth2 app creation and access tokens in Settings -> Advanced.

apps.name: Amazon Selling Partner
apps.one_liner: Official Amazon Seller & Vendor API for orders, listings, FBA inventory, and reports.
apps.main_blocker: Strict Login with Amazon (LWA) OAuth2 + Seller Central developer registration, security assessment, and restricted-role review for PII.
apps.notes: AWS SigV4 requirement was retired in favor of LWA OAuth2, but developer profile vetting and PII role approval remain a major gating wall.

apps.name: fanbasis
apps.one_liner: Creator & digital-business checkout, subscriptions, and payments platform (now Commas).
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Verified live docs: FanBasis developer platform rebranded as Commas (commasdocs.com); scoped x-api-key on fanbasis.com/public-api/* + free sandbox (api-sandbox.commas.net).

apps.name: DataForSEO
apps.one_liner: Pay-as-you-go SERP, keyword, backlink, and domain intelligence APIs.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Verified live docs: $1 free trial credit + pay-as-you-go; Base64 Basic Auth (login:password) and official remote + local MCP server.

apps.name: SE Ranking
apps.one_liner: SEO rank tracking, site audit, keyword research, and competitor analytics platform.
apps.main_blocker: API access requires Business plan or standalone Data API subscription.
apps.notes: Verified live docs: REST API + official remote MCP endpoint (api.seranking.com/mcp); gated behind paid tier/API subscription.

apps.name: Ahrefs
apps.one_liner: Backlink index, keyword explorer, and domain SEO intelligence platform.
apps.main_blocker: API v3 requires Enterprise plan (starting ~$1,499/mo) for full access; lower plans only get free test queries on ahrefs.com.
apps.notes: Official MCP & API v3 Bearer tokens exist, but Enterprise pricing wall makes credential provisioning expensive for non-enterprise users.

apps.name: MrScraper
apps.one_liner: AI-powered stealth web scraping, SERP extraction, and workflow platform.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Verified Sep 2026 docs: Self-serve API token from app.mrscraper.com, async REST API, Python/Node SDKs, CLI, and official MCP server.

apps.name: Apify
apps.one_liner: Cloud web scraping and browser automation platform hosting 130K+ Actors.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Verified live docs: Free monthly credits, Bearer API token + OAuth2, and official hosted MCP server exposing Actor store & datasets.

apps.name: Firecrawl
apps.one_liner: LLM-ready web scraping, crawling, search, and structured extraction API.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free tier (500 credits), clean REST API with Bearer API key, official MCP server, and already a staple agent tool.

apps.name: Bright Data
apps.one_liner: Enterprise proxy network, web unlocker, SERP API, and structured web datasets.
apps.main_blocker: Free trial available, but KYC/identity verification is often required to unlock unrestricted web-scraping zones.
apps.notes: Bearer API tokens + official Web MCP server; compliance/KYC check can pause instant production scraping on sensitive targets.

apps.name: Sherlock
apps.one_liner: Open-source Python CLI tool for hunting usernames across 400+ social networks.
apps.main_blocker: No hosted API or auth; must be wrapped as a sandboxed CLI execution skill with outbound rate-limit/proxy care.
apps.notes: Classic non-API trap: open-source CLI package (pip install sherlock-project). Best shipped as an agent CLI skill in a sandbox container.

apps.name: Waterfall.io
apps.one_liner: Waterfall B2B contact, phone, email, and company intelligence enrichment API.
apps.main_blocker: Docs explicitly require contacting the Waterfall team for API key provisioning and pricing; no self-serve signup.
apps.notes: Verified live Mintlify docs: REST API at api.waterfall.io/v1/ with x-api-key header + async Launcher/Finder pattern, but sales-gated credentials.

apps.name: Clay
apps.one_liner: GTM data enrichment orchestrator combining 150+ data providers and AI agents.
apps.main_blocker: Official MCP is OAuth 2.1-only (no static API key for headless loops); Public API (clay-api-key) requires paid/Enterprise plans for full table queries.
apps.notes: Verified Aug 2026 architecture: Clay now exposes hosted/local MCP (OAuth 2.1 only) AND Public API (clay-api-key), with different capabilities on each.

apps.name: GitHub
apps.one_liner: Source code hosting, pull requests, issues, Actions CI/CD, and security platform.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Gold-standard developer platform: free tier, OAuth Apps, GitHub Apps (JWT), fine-grained PATs, and official hosted + local MCP server.

apps.name: Vercel
apps.one_liner: Frontend cloud platform for Next.js/web deployments, edge functions, and domains.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free Hobby tier; Bearer tokens self-serve in dashboard, OAuth2 via Vercel Integrations, and official remote Vercel MCP server.

apps.name: Netlify
apps.one_liner: Web deployment, serverless functions, forms, and edge hosting platform.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Verified live docs: Free tier, OAuth2 + PATs, and official @netlify/mcp server bridging API and CLI.

apps.name: Cloudflare
apps.one_liner: Global edge network, DNS, Workers serverless compute, R2 storage, and WAF.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free tier with scoped Bearer API tokens and suite of official first-party remote Cloudflare MCP servers (Workers, DNS, Observability, Docs).

apps.name: Supabase
apps.one_liner: Open-source Postgres developer platform with Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, and Realtime.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Verified live docs: Free tier, Management API (OAuth2 + PAT) plus PostgREST Data API (anon/service_role keys), and official hosted MCP.

apps.name: Neo4j
apps.one_liner: Native graph database and AuraDB managed cloud platform with Cypher query API.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free AuraDB instance; Aura Admin API uses OAuth2 Client Credentials while Query API v2 uses Basic Auth over HTTP.

apps.name: Snowflake
apps.one_liner: Cloud data warehouse and AI data cloud with SQL REST API and Cortex services.
apps.main_blocker: 30-day free trial; account-specific URLs and strict enterprise security (key-pair JWT / Programmatic Access Tokens / OAuth2; password auth deprecated).
apps.notes: SQL REST API + Cortex Managed MCP; requires account locator/org-account URL and key-pair JWT or OAuth2 setup.

apps.name: MongoDB Atlas
apps.one_liner: Managed cloud MongoDB database platform with Administration API and cluster controls.
apps.main_blocker: Atlas Admin API uses HTTP Digest Auth (public/private key) or Service Account OAuth2, plus IP Access List enforcement.
apps.notes: Free M0 cluster; Service Account OAuth2 recommended over legacy Digest API keys. Official MongoDB MCP server available.

apps.name: Datadog
apps.one_liner: Cloud infrastructure monitoring, APM traces, logs, metrics, and alerting platform.
apps.main_blocker: Requires dual-key auth (DD-API-KEY + DD-APPLICATION-KEY) and regional site routing (US1/US3/US5/EU1); OAuth2 for marketplace partners.
apps.notes: 14-day free trial; comprehensive v1/v2 REST API and official remote Datadog MCP server for logs, metrics, and monitors.

apps.name: Sentry
apps.one_liner: Application error tracking, performance monitoring, and session replay for developers.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free Developer tier; User Auth Tokens, Internal Integrations, OAuth2 public apps, and official hosted Sentry MCP server.

apps.name: Notion
apps.one_liner: Connected workspace for docs, wikis, databases, and collaborative knowledge.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free tier + instant internal/public OAuth2 integrations; official hosted Notion MCP works on every plan (headless MCP tokens require Business+).

apps.name: Airtable
apps.one_liner: Cloud spreadsheet-database hybrid for operational workflows and low-code apps.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free tier supports scoped PATs and OAuth2 (PKCE); 5 req/sec per base rate limit is the main operational constraint.

apps.name: Linear
apps.one_liner: High-speed issue tracking, cycles, and product roadmapping tool for engineering teams.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free plan includes full GraphQL API, OAuth2, personal API keys, and official hosted MCP (mcp.linear.app/mcp) with read-only mode.

apps.name: Jira
apps.one_liner: Enterprise agile issue tracking, sprints, and project workflow management by Atlassian.
apps.main_blocker: Cloud uses OAuth 2.0 (3LO) with per-site cloudId lookup or Basic Auth; Jira Data Center/Server uses different PAT endpoints.
apps.notes: Free Cloud tier up to 10 users; official Atlassian Rovo MCP (mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp) is Cloud-only and consumes Rovo credits.

apps.name: Asana
apps.one_liner: Work management platform for tasks, projects, portfolios, and cross-team workflows.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free Personal tier; clean REST API with PATs and OAuth2, plus official V2 Streamable HTTP MCP server (OAuth-only).

apps.name: Monday.com
apps.one_liner: Visual Work OS with customizable boards, pipelines, automations, and dashboards.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free developer account; GraphQL-only API with complexity-based rate limits and official hosted + local MCP available on all plans.

apps.name: ClickUp
apps.one_liner: All-in-one productivity platform combining tasks, docs, chat, and time tracking.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free Forever plan includes REST API (Personal Token + OAuth2) and official 65-tool hosted MCP (OAuth-only, 100 calls/day on Free).

apps.name: Coda
apps.one_liner: All-in-one collaborative docs blending spreadsheets, tables, buttons, and Packs.
apps.main_blocker: REST API uses user-generated Bearer API tokens only (no public OAuth2 flow for third-party multi-tenant connectors).
apps.notes: Free tier includes full REST API for docs, tables, and rows; lack of public OAuth2 means users must paste personal tokens.

apps.name: Smartsheet
apps.one_liner: Enterprise spreadsheet-style project management, resource planning, and dashboards.
apps.main_blocker: 30-day free trial / developer sandbox, but public OAuth app registration requires Smartsheet review; paid plan needed after trial.
apps.notes: Well-documented REST API with Bearer tokens and OAuth2; enterprise-oriented seat pricing after trial.

apps.name: Harvest
apps.one_liner: Time tracking, expense logging, and client invoicing tool for agencies and services.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Free tier available; clean REST API v2 supporting Personal Access Tokens and OAuth2 (requires Harvest-Account-Id header).

apps.name: Stripe
apps.one_liner: Global online payments, billing, subscriptions, invoicing, and financial infrastructure.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Instant free Test Mode/Sandboxes; Restricted API Keys + Stripe Connect OAuth. Official Stripe MCP enforces Dashboard approval on sensitive actions like refunds.

apps.name: Plaid
apps.one_liner: Financial data network connecting apps to users' bank accounts, balances, and transactions.
apps.main_blocker: Sandbox is free and instant, but Production requires business vetting, security questionnaire, and bank OAuth approval; client_id + secret in body.
apps.notes: Classic two-tier fintech gate: easy Sandbox prototyping, heavy compliance and contract review for live Production bank connections.

apps.name: Binance
apps.one_liner: Global cryptocurrency exchange with spot, margin, futures trading, and market-data APIs.
apps.main_blocker: Signed endpoints require HMAC-SHA256 / Ed25519 request signing + KYC-verified account; strict geo-restrictions (e.g., US users blocked on binance.com).
apps.notes: Free testnet + public market endpoints; authenticated trading requires KYC account, IP allowlisting, and cryptographic payload signing.

apps.name: Paygent Connect
apps.one_liner: White-label NMI-powered payment gateway wrapper for card processing and merchant billing.
apps.main_blocker: No public standalone developer docs; white-label NMI merchant underwriting/ISO partner approval required for security_key credentials.
apps.notes: Honest uncertainty flag: public docs for Paygent Connect specifically are unavailable; confirmed NMI-powered gateway architecture via NMI docs.

apps.name: iPayX
apps.one_liner: Neutral FX transaction verification and spread-auditing layer for fintech and treasury teams.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Verified live docs: Bearer token (ipx_live_/ipx_test_) from dashboard; free tier (10 FX audits/day, 60 mid-market calls/min), paid ($199) for forensic reports. Official MCP.

apps.name: QuickBooks
apps.one_liner: Small-business accounting, invoicing, payroll, and bookkeeping platform by Intuit.
apps.main_blocker: Free Sandbox companies, but Production keys require Intuit app review, compliance questionnaire, and public HTTPS callback.
apps.notes: OAuth 2.0 per-realmId; Intuit GitHub hosts a 145-tool local QuickBooks Online MCP server.

apps.name: Xero
apps.one_liner: Cloud accounting software for SMB invoices, bank feeds, contacts, and financial reports.
apps.main_blocker: Free Demo Company + up to 25 org connections self-serve; scaling past 25 connections requires Xero App Store certification.
apps.notes: Standard OAuth2 with PKCE + Custom Connections; official MIT-licensed @xeroapi/xero-mcp-server covers contacts, invoices, and P&L reports.

apps.name: Brex
apps.one_liner: Corporate cards, spend management, bill pay, and treasury platform for businesses.
apps.main_blocker: Requires an approved Brex business customer account for User Tokens; multi-tenant OAuth2 requires Brex partner approval.
apps.notes: Clean REST API + official Brex MCP for expenses/cards, but gated to approved corporate customers or vetted integration partners.

apps.name: Ramp
apps.one_liner: Corporate card, expense automation, procurement, and accounting platform.
apps.main_blocker: Sandbox available for Ramp customers/partners, but OAuth2 Client Credentials & Authorization Code require an active business account or Ramp Partner approval.
apps.notes: Modern REST API with fine-grained OAuth2 scopes; gated behind US corporate customer eligibility or Ramp tech partnership.

apps.name: PitchBook
apps.one_liner: Private-market financial data platform for VC, PE, M&A, and company valuations.
apps.main_blocker: API is a separate enterprise contract sold via PitchBook's Direct Data team; no self-serve trial or public endpoint specs.
apps.notes: Verified live docs: REST API at api.pitchbook.com with API key/token, strictly gated behind standalone enterprise contract and Direct Data team outreach.

apps.name: NotebookLM
apps.one_liner: Google's grounded notebook and audio-overview workspace (Enterprise API on GCP).
apps.main_blocker: No consumer API; NotebookLM Enterprise API requires Google Cloud project + Gemini/NotebookLM Enterprise license and IAM role (roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmUser).
apps.notes: Verified live GCP docs: Discovery Engine REST API with multi-region endpoints (us/eu/global) and GCP OAuth2/IAM, gated to Enterprise licensing.

apps.name: Otter AI
apps.one_liner: AI meeting transcription, summaries, and conversational search assistant.
apps.main_blocker: No general public REST API; integration is exclusively via Otter's official remote MCP server (mcp.otter.ai/mcp) using OAuth.
apps.notes: Verified Oct 30 2026 Help Center: official Streamable HTTP MCP server with OAuth exposes user info, meeting search, and transcript fetch.

apps.name: Fathom
apps.one_liner: AI meeting recorder and summary assistant for Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Verified live docs: Fathom ships both a developer REST API and an official remote MCP server at https://api.fathom.ai/mcp.

apps.name: Consensus
apps.one_liner: AI academic search engine across 400M+ peer-reviewed research papers.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Verified Oct 2026 docs: Free account unlocks API & MCP Dashboard; supports OAuth 2.0 dynamic discovery AND Bearer API keys on mcp.consensus.app/mcp + api.consensus.app/v1/search.

apps.name: Reducto
apps.one_liner: Vision-first document parsing, structured extraction, and splitting API for PDFs/tables.
apps.main_blocker: None
apps.notes: Verified live docs: Free trial credits, REST API + official hosted (mcp.reducto.ai/mcp) & local (uvx mcp-server-reducto) MCP supporting API keys and OAuth device-code flow.

apps.name: Devin
apps.one_liner: Autonomous AI software engineering agent by Cognition with session & org APIs.
apps.main_blocker: Requires active paid Devin org/enterprise plan; v3 API & Devin MCP strictly require cog_-prefixed Service User or PAT tokens (legacy apk_ keys rejected).
apps.notes: Verified live docs: Principal + token model (Bearer cog_...) with RBAC service users; official Devin MCP requires cog_ keys.

apps.name: higgsfield
apps.one_liner: Generative AI video, motion-transfer, and image creation platform with async API and CLI.
apps.main_blocker: Hint pointed to /cli, but Higgsfield exposes a full async REST API (docs.higgsfield.ai) using custom Authorization: Key {ID}:{SECRET} header + paid usage credits.
apps.notes: Verified live docs: Async submit-and-poll/webhook model at api.higgsfield.ai with Python/TS SDKs and CLI; requires Console API key & credits.

apps.name: Mermaid CLI
apps.one_liner: Open-source CLI rendering Mermaid text diagrams to SVG, PNG, and PDF via headless Chromium.
apps.main_blocker: No hosted API or auth; runs locally via npx @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli (mmdc) and requires Puppeteer/Chromium in sandbox.
apps.notes: Classic CLI-only tool: ideal as a sandboxed agent skill or local MCP wrapper rather than a cloud OAuth connector.

apps.name: YouTube Transcript
apps.one_liner: Third-party YouTube transcript, caption, and channel metadata extraction API.
apps.main_blocker: Third-party wrapper (not official Google/YouTube API); requires active credit plan for transcript endpoint (video info endpoint is free).
apps.notes: Verified Nov 2026 docs: Bearer token auth, language priority + ASR fallback, and official MCP integration for Claude/ChatGPT.

apps.name: Grain
apps.one_liner: AI meeting recording, highlight clips, notes, and CRM sync platform.
apps.main_blocker: Personal Access Tokens are instant, but OAuth2 client_id/secret must be requested manually from Grain and Workspace scope requires paid plan.
apps.notes: Verified live docs: PAT/WAT/OAuth2+PKCE tokens, public REST API, and official Grain MCP docs linked directly from developer portal.
